rows.name: po_due
rows.comment: Off unless the deployment sets has_proximal_outcomes (only mx does). @calc makes it a real true/false so !@local.po_due works.

rows.name: po_due_type
rows.comment: Which check-in is due (same rule as home_screen_header). Written as the exact opposite of the 14-day row so a missing prox_14d_last_ts falls back to 7days.

rows.name: show_po
rows.comment: Set to true with set_local at hand-over; keeps the check-in on screen even when the timestamps change.

rows.name: header
rows.comment: uncompleted closes + shows the certificate (only reached when close_emits is on)

rows.name: close_emits
rows.comment: After the check-in has been opened (po_active) and certificates are on: the header's X emits 'uncompleted' instead of closing, so this row's actions close + show the certificate.

rows.name: if_yes
rows.comment: condition extended. No check-in due: unchanged.

rows.name: if_yes_then_checkin
rows.comment: Copy of if_yes for when a check-in is due: certificate is generated, then the check-in shows; pop-up + toast come after it.

rows.name: completion_icon
rows.comment: arrow instead of the trophy: the check-in follows.

rows.name: if_yes_return
rows.comment: The review shown again after 'back' from the check-in. Finishing it only goes back to the check-in: no second certificate, no data saved again. po_setup_pending is left as it is.

rows.name: if_yes_no_certificates
if_yes_no_certificates_then_checkin
rows.comment: Copy of if_yes_no_certificates for when a check-in is due

rows.name: if_yes_no_certificates_return
proximal_outcome_page_7
rows.comment: After the check-in: close, then certificate pop-up + toast (what the review did before).
